documents.title: Tracking issue for eRFC 2497, "if- and while-let-chains, take 2" · Issue #53667 · rust-lang/rust · GitHub

blocks.text:
Issue body actions

# Note: This feature was stabilized in 1.88.0 but on edition 2024 only. If you are using 1.88.0+ and get an error that the feature is still unstable, please upgrade the edition.

This is a tracking issue for the eRFC "if- and while-let-chains, take 2" (rust-lang/rfcs#2497).
For the tracking issue for the immediate edition changes, see #53668.

Steps:

  * [Input] Implement the RFC (cc @rust-lang/compiler -- can anyone write up mentoring instructions?)
  * [Input] Adjust documentation (see instructions on forge)
  * [Input] Formatting for new syntax has been added to the Style Guide (nightly-style-procedure)
  * [Input] resolve expr fragment specifier issue (#86730)
  * [Input] Initial stabilization PR: Stabilize `let_chains` in Rust 1.64 #94927, reverted in Revert let_chains stabilization #100538
  * [Input] Second stabilization PR: Stabilize let chains in the 2024 edition #132833
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
